episodes.title: Medieval Europe
episodes.description: Survey medieval events, including the Black Death, Hundred Years’ War, and Western Schism, that shaped Europe before the Renaissance.

episodes.title: Florence and the Renaissance
episodes.description: Today you'll learn about how the Renaissance came to be, and what impact it had on Europe and the world.

episodes.title: The Northern Renaissance
episodes.description: Trace the spread of Renaissance art, architecture, literature, and humanism from Italy into other European regions.

episodes.title: The Age of Exploration
episodes.description: Explore the technologies and motives behind European exploration and conquest during the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries.

episodes.title: Expansion and Consequences
episodes.description: Examine the exchange of food, animals, diseases, wealth, and people between Europe and the Americas, including its devastating colonial consequences.

episodes.title: The Protestant Reformation
episodes.description: Trace the religious tensions and reform movements that divided European Christianity during the Protestant Reformation.

episodes.title: Reformation and Consequences
episodes.description: Explore how Calvin, the Tudors, and the Huguenots reshaped religious and state power during the Reformation.

episodes.title: Commerce, Agriculture, and Slavery
episodes.description: Examine how advances in agriculture and commerce intersected with the expansion of the Atlantic slave trade.

episodes.title: Catholic Counter-Reformation
episodes.description: John Green will teach you about the Council of Trent, the rise of the Jesuits, and Saint Teresa of Avila.

episodes.title: Witchcraft
episodes.description: Explore how war, disease, religious conflict, and social upheaval encouraged witchcraft accusations and scapegoating in Europe.

episodes.title: The 17th Century Crisis
episodes.description: Examine the Thirty Years’ War and the disease, hunger, and climatic pressures that afflicted seventeenth-century Europe.

episodes.title: Scientific Revolution
episodes.description: In this video, we'll look at the progress of knowledge of Galileo, Copernicus, Kepler, Harvey, Newton, and more.

episodes.title: Absolute Monarchy
episodes.description: John traces the rise of absolute monarchy, starting with France’s Louis XIV.

episodes.title: English Civil War
episodes.description: Follow England’s civil war and changing rulers from the early Stuarts through Cromwell and the Restoration.

episodes.title: Dutch Golden Age
episodes.description: Today, we'll learn about how the Dutch came to their Golden Age, and how it ended.

episodes.title: Eastern Europe Consolidates
episodes.description: You'll learn about the various Ivans in Russia and the Time of Trouble that followed them, and you'll learn about the Ottomans' expansion into Europe.

episodes.title: The Rise of Russia and Prussia
episodes.description: Explore Russia’s modernization under Peter the Great and Prussia’s increasingly efficient institutions and military power.

episodes.title: The Enlightenment
episodes.description: Explore Enlightenment thinkers, including Voltaire, Rousseau, Kant, and Smith, and their continuing influence on political and social ideas.

episodes.title: Enlightened Monarchs
episodes.description: Explore how European monarchs adopted Enlightenment ideas, including rulers in Russia, Prussia, the Habsburg lands, and France.

episodes.title: 18th Century Warfare
episodes.description: European powers had a lot of wars in the 18th century, and they weren't confined to Europe.

episodes.title: The French Revolution
episodes.description: Trace the French Revolution through its institutions, declarations, violence, and contested accomplishments.

episodes.title: Napoleon Bonaparte
episodes.description: Join us as we track the rise, further rise, fall, rise, fall, mortal fall, and posthumous rise of Napoleon.

episodes.title: The Congress of Vienna
episodes.description: Explore the Congress of Vienna’s conservative restoration and the Romantic movement that accompanied Europe’s reaction to the Napoleonic Wars.

episodes.title: The Industrial Revolution
episodes.description: You'll learn about the development of steam power and mechanization, and the labor and social movements that this revolution engendered.

episodes.title: Reform and Revolution 1815-1848
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the revolutions and upheaval in 18th and early 19th century Europe, there was a hunger for reform across the continent.

episodes.title: Revolutions of 1848
episodes.description: Examine the participants, aims, and outcomes of Europe’s 1848 revolutions across the Habsburg lands, Italy, German states, and Poland.

episodes.title: Italian and German Unification
episodes.description: Today we'll look at how Italy and Germany pulled it together in the second half of the 1800s.

episodes.title: Expansion and Resistance
episodes.description: You'll learn about China and the Opium War, British India, and the Scramble for Africa.

episodes.title: Migration
episodes.description: Between 1840 and 1914, an estimated 40 million people left Europe.

episodes.title: Modern Life
episodes.description: Explore urban growth, changing communications, and women’s advances as European life changed around the turn of the twentieth century.

episodes.title: Modern Thought and Culture in 1900
episodes.description: Explore modern science and artistic Modernism through Impressionist painting and Stravinsky’s music and dance.

episodes.title: The Roads to World War I
episodes.description: Examine the alliances, earlier conflicts, and assassination of Franz Ferdinand that helped lead to the First World War.

episodes.title: World War I Battlefields
episodes.description: We're talking about the military history of World War I and taking a look at the broad strokes of how the war unfolded.

episodes.title: WWI’s Civilians, the Homefront, and an Uneasy Peace
episodes.description: Examine civilian life and women’s wartime work during World War I, then assess the uneasy peace that followed.

episodes.title: Russian Revolution and Civil War
episodes.description: Trace Russia’s revolutions of 1917, Bolshevik rule, civil war, and the formation of the Soviet Union.

episodes.title: Post-World War I Recovery
episodes.description: In which John Green looks at Europe's attempts to recover from the devastation of World War I and forge a lasting peace.

episodes.title: Economic Depression and Dictators
episodes.description: Examine how economic depression helped militaristic dictatorships rise in Germany, the Soviet Union, Japan, and Spain.

episodes.title: World War II
episodes.description: Follow the Second World War from the invasion of Poland through its European fronts and the war’s end.

episodes.title: World War II Civilians and Soldiers
episodes.description: Compare how World War II affected soldiers and civilians across different combatant countries.

episodes.title: The Holocaust, Genocides, and Mass Murder of WWII
episodes.description: Examine the Holocaust and Nazi persecution and mass murder of Jewish people and other targeted populations during World War II.

episodes.title: Post-War Rebuilding and the Cold War
episodes.description: Explore postwar Europe’s weakened powers, Soviet expansion, American rebuilding efforts, and the emergence of the Cold War.

episodes.title: Post-World War II Recovery
episodes.description: Explore postwar European reconstruction, the Marshall Plan, and treaties that laid foundations for the European Union.

episodes.title: Decolonization
episodes.description: Explore how European colonial empires unraveled after the Second World War.

episodes.title: Revolutions in Science and Tech
episodes.description: Explore postwar advances in biology, communications, energy, space exploration, and medicine and their effects on everyday life.

episodes.title: Protests East and West
episodes.description: Examine how Cold War tensions, slowing growth, and unequal prosperity fueled protests and dissent in postwar Europe.

episodes.title: The Soviet Bloc Unwinds
episodes.description: Examine protests and political change from Polish strikes and East German dissent to the Berlin Wall’s fall and Soviet collapse.

episodes.title: The Fall of Communism
episodes.description: In this video, you'll learn how countries like Czechoslovakia, Yugoslavia, Poland, and many others moved into the post-Soviet world.

episodes.title: Europe in the Global Age
episodes.description: Examine how global connections in trade, communications, and disease have shaped European life.

episodes.title: 21st Century Challenges
episodes.description: Explore financial crises, migration, polarization, populism, and Brexit as challenges facing twenty-first-century Europe.

episodes.title: What History Was, Is, and Will Be
episodes.description: Reflect on the development and purposes of historical study and how historians should research and write in the future.
